Search [existing Relay issues](https://github.com/N7Steve/Relay/issues) first.
Use the bug report template for broken behavior. For installation questions,
read [the Relay Docker guide](https://github.com/N7Steve/Relay/blob/main/docs/hosting/docker.md).

## Request

Describe the problem or intended behavior, how it helps your use of Relay and
any relevant installation details. Remove private financial data and credentials
from screenshots and logs.
